title: B-Smart Slim Twist 510 Pen
description:
The Yocan B-Smart Battery is a small and compact 510-threaded vaporizer battery that accommodates a wide variety of 510-threaded attachments allowing you to enjoy a wide array of cartridges and atomizers that’ll suit your style and needs. It’s a compact companion you can take almost wherever you may go. This battery is its variable voltage settings. You can enjoy temperature profiles from 2.0 volts to 4.0 volts.

Features & Specifications

- Heat-up Time: 10s

- Size: 86 x 11 mm

- Battery Capacity: 320 mAh

- Output Voltage: 2V – 4V

Package Contents

- 1x Yocan B-Smart Battery

- 1x 510 Thread Charger
